criteria.description: One brand, one permanent bar CTA, one toggle, five primary destinations, contact block (heading + phone + email + address), five social destinations, zero dropdowns/chevrons
Toggle opens/closes left ren-sheet; Escape restores focus from a focused destination; outside/backdrop close; every destination class closes the drawer; same-breakpoint resize stays stable
One primary tree/landmark, one toggle close morph, no duplicate mobile chrome or chevrons
Bar keeps logo start and action+toggle end at all widths; left drawer geometry; no root overflow at 320/340 and 767/768/769 seams
JavaScript-disabled view exposes the one primary tree, contact, social destinations, and permanent CTA without relying on the toggle
Visible focus, fully visible 44px targets, reduced motion, light/dark tokens, public DOM/ARIA only, axe WCAG 2.1 AA
Codex reviewed fresh desktop, tablet, mobile, dark, and JavaScript-disabled captures
